evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet transaction creation in src/wallet/spend.cpp and src/wallet/feebumper.cpp.
rationale: Prevents fee-bumped transactions from having an earlier locktime than the transaction they replace, fixing an on-chain fingerprinting vector. While privacy of transaction creation matters in wallet, empirical data shows this affects fewer than 2% of replacements (200-300 per week), making it a worthwhile fix that is reasonably deferrable.
